latest_release.name: v2.4.0
latest_release.body:
## Security fixes

v2.4.0 fixes six vulnerabilities in three servers. Upgrade `@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem` to 2.3.0,
and `mcp-server-git` and `mcp-server-fetch` to 2026.11.11.

| Package | Affected | Fixed in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem` | all versions before 2.3.0, and date versions 2025.1.14 through 2026.8.31 | 2.3.0 |
| `mcp-server-git` | through 2026.11.4 | 2026.11.11 |
| `mcp-server-fetch` | through 2026.11.4 | 2026.11.11 |

### `@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem` 2.3.0

* **Reads stay with the file that was checked** (Linux and macOS). The read tools and file resources now open a file relative to the directory that was checked, as writes already did, so a directory swapped for a symlink between the access check and the read can no longer return a file from outside the allowed directories. A FIFO, socket or device is refused rather than read. **On Windows this narrows the race without closing it**, as for writes (#5260) ([GHSA-p9cv-8g75-4xcg](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-p9cv-8g75-4xcg))
* **`move_file` moves only the source it checked.** A move within one device first takes the source out of its own checked directory under a fresh name, so a source directory swapped for a symlink can no longer bring an outside file into the allowed directories, where it would become readable ([GHSA-7m4x-rv66-mxhh](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-7m4x-rv66-mxhh))

### `mcp-server-git` 2026.11.11

* **A repository's own Git configuration can no longer make the server run a program.** A read-only call such as `git_status` on an untrusted repository used to run a command named in its `.git/config` (`core.fsmonitor`, `diff.external`, hooks, filter and merge drivers, signing) with the server's privileges. Every Git command now overrides those settings, and a Git older than 2.31, which would ignore the overrides, is refused ([GHSA-6hqx-gqrx-c5r2](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-6hqx-gqrx-c5r2))
* **`--repository` confinement covers alternate object stores, linked worktrees and links in the Git directory.** A repository inside the allowed one could read another repository's objects through `objects/info/alternates`, or pass a linked worktree's Git directory off as the allowed repository's. Both are refused, as is a symlink in a Git directory that leads outside the allowed repository. **On Windows a directory junction is not yet covered** (#5520) ([GHSA-q74p-4wrc-q7w6](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-q74p-4wrc-q7w6))

### `mcp-server-fetch` 2026.11.11

* **IPv6 site-local addresses are private.** The private-address guard read `fec0::/10` as public. It is now refused, and so is any IPv6 address outside global unicast (`2000::/3`) that does not carry an IPv4 address ([GHSA-3rxj-6jhw-qfv7](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-3rxj-6jhw-qfv7))
* **robots.txt is matched against the path the site will resolve**, as well as the path as written, so `//private` or `/x/../private` can no longer get past `Disallow: /private` ([GHSA-f9hh-cmx9-2f23](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-f9hh-cmx9-2f23))

### Upgrading from a date-versioned npm release

The TypeScript servers moved from date versions (2025.x, 2026.x) to semantic versions in 1.0.0. Package managers rank 2.3.0 below every 2025.x and 2026.x version, so they won't offer it as an upgrade. If you are on a date version of `@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem`, install 2.3.0 explicitly: `npm install @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem@2.3.0`.
